predecessors.name: Abbasid Caliphate
predecessors.text: Khorasan, the governorate given to Tahir ibn Husayn in 821 as a reward for his support of al-Ma'mun in the Fourth Fitna

successors.name: Saffarid dynasty
successors.text: Khorasan, annexed by Ya'qub ibn al-Layth in 873 (Herat already taken in 870)

successors.name: Samanid Empire
successors.text: Transoxiana, where Samanid governors had served under Tahirid overlordship; the pages opened give no year for the Samanids' independence

ledger.x: 821: al-Ma'mun's general Tahir is made governor of Khorasan, the start of the Tahirid dynasty.
821: Transoxiana's governors answer to the governor of Khorasan.
828: Talha occupies Zarang, the city of Sistan.
830: Abdallah ibn Tahir settles at Nishapur.
839: Mazyar is betrayed and handed over; Tabaristan passes to the Tahirids.
861: Sistan lost to the Saffarid rebels.
864: Tabaristan rebels and 'declaring their allegiance to the independent Zaydi ruler Hasan ibn Zayd in 864' (Tahirid page, same year).
864: the Tahirids fight for Tabaristan; the Tahirid viceroy Sulayman ibn Abdallah ibn Tahir was Hasan's main opponent.
870: Ya'qub's offensive against Khorasan begins with Herat (he 'began attacks on Khorasan, Khuzestan, Kerman and Fars'; the page dates only Herat, 870, and the annexation of Khorasan, 873).
873: the fighting ends with the Saffarid annexation of Khorasan.
873: Ya'qub ibn al-Layth takes Khorasan and Nishapur.
873: Tahirid overlordship over Transoxiana ends with the dynasty.

wars.name: Tahirid campaigns against the Kharijites of Sistan
wars.outcome: Talha "failed to remove the Kharijites from Sistan"; after their leader died in 828 the Tahirids occupied Zarang but never collected taxes in the countryside.

wars.name: Revolt of Mazyar in Tabaristan
wars.outcome: Mazyar, who resisted Tahirid claims over his tribute, was captured and executed in 839; Tabaristan passed to the Tahirids with Qarin I restored as a Bavand vassal.

wars.name: Hasan ibn Zayd's rebellion in Tabaristan
wars.outcome: The Zaydi Alid Hasan ibn Zayd was proclaimed emir in 864, chased out by Sulayman ibn Abdallah in 865 and returned the same year to recover the province.

wars.name: Saffarid conquest of Khorasan
wars.outcome: Ya'qub ibn al-Layth took Herat in 870 and annexed Khorasan in 873, ending the Tahirid dynasty.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey lines: the frontiers follow the governorate of Khorasan (Herat, Balkh, Merv, Nishapur) and the cities named; the Transoxiana and Zarang holdings are approximate.
